description: This file defines the InOperator class, which implements filter and SQL comparison operators for the JSON API filters in SuiteCRM. It extends a base Operator class and implements the OperatorInterface, providing functionality specific to the 'in' comparator used to filter records based on membership in a set.

classes.name: InOperator
classes.description: Implements the 'in' comparison operator for filtering, providing methods to generate filter and SQL representations and validate operands.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the given operator string is valid for this comparator, throws an InvalidArgumentException if not a string.

methods.name: totalOperands
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of operands supported, which is 255.

methods.name: toSqlOperands
methods.description: Formats the operands into a SQL-compatible string enclosed in parentheses.
